basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm Alex, a 25-year-old tech enthusiast from Bucharest. I've recently dived into the world of Reddit to explore various interests and connect with like-minded individuals. I work as a junior software developer and spend most of my day coding and learning new programming languages. During my free time, I enjoy gaming, especially playing League of Legends, which led me to the RazorMains community. I'm also curious about AI and how it integrates into everyday life, which is why I started lurking on the Replika subreddit. I'm single and love exploring new places around my city during weekends. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work. Not a big fan of negativity, so I try to keep my interactions positive.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having completed my degree last year. My knowledge primarily comes from university courses and self-teaching through online resources and coding bootcamps. I'm particularly interested in AI and machine learning and often find myself exploring new advancements in these fields.
